findings.desc: packages/main/src/handlers/quorum-submit.ts:230-255 [HIGH] The claimed exact causal envelope is validated only by event type + verdictId. A concurrent mutation can keep those two fields while changing hostId/sessionId/keyId/decision/materialDigest/storyFilesHash/validationDigest/promptDigest; assertExactQuorumAppend then accepts and the immutable transaction commits the forged L4 host_verdict row. This contradicts CHK-002 happy:1/adversarial:1 and the new process-fact atomic-persistence claim. Compare every persisted row against the full canonical event derived from the returned verdict/bindings (or bind exact generated bytes/digests), and add a focused mutation test that preserves verdictId while altering a gate-consumed field and proves refusal/rollback. The same exact-byte ownership rule should govern ignored verdict-file rollback: lines 321-326 delete a concurrently changed file solely because verdictId still matches, so foreign bytes can be lost.

packages/main/src/tasks/quorum-submit-smoke.ts:106-134,357-399 — HIGH coverage gap: the 27-intent evidence marks CHK-001 happy:0/happy:1/edge:0/adversarial:0/adversarial:2 and CHK-003 happy:0/adversarial:0 as covered by this smoke, but the smoke creates a synthetic temp repository with synthetic PASS evidence and invokes registry.get("quorum_submit") directly; it never invokes the worktree-local CLI, never runs the validation persistence path, never demonstrates the historical validation refusal/no-false-PASS boundary, and never proves the harness rejects a direct-handler-only shortcut. The only post-quorum check at lines 390-399 calls captureLifecycleMetadataTransaction and expects success after GREEN. The sole pre-dirty case at lines 579-592 is an untracked user file, not the separately required pre-dirty process-events plus staged/source/lifecycle cases. Thus several MUST intents are contradicted or only narratively attested while checklist evidence claims executable coverage. Add a bounded production-entry integration that runs node bin/lattice.js quorum_submit in a real fixture/worktree and exercises the validation persistence refusal on the RED implementation (or bind a concrete immutable historical receipt), plus the explicitly required pre-dirty categories; keep the existing fast handler matrix for fault injection.

packages/main/src/handlers/quorum-submit.ts:398-410 and packages/main/src/tasks/quorum-submit-smoke.ts:489-512 — HIGH: same-material duplicate refusal trusts listVerdicts(), whose .lattice/autopilot-verdicts JSON files are gitignored/non-durable, instead of the canonical committed host_verdict events. Deleting that ignored directory after a successful quorum makes the same-material retry emit and commit another six rows, violating the explicit idempotency contract. The current smoke only tests while ignored JSON remains. Derive duplicate detection from committed process-events (exact runId/material binding), and add a regression that removes/loses the cache before retry.
